verified_metadata.title: Physically informed data-driven modeling of active nematics
verified_metadata.abstract: SPIDER uses weak-form sparse regression and symmetry-constrained libraries to discover interpretable active-nematic field equations directly from microtubule experiments.
verified_metadata.comment: Open-access Science Advances article with public MATLAB code

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Matthew Golden、Roman O. Grigoriev、Jyothishraj Nambisan、Alberto Fernández-Nieves；Science Advances 9, eabq6120 (2023)，DOI:10.1126/sciadv.abq6120。核验 arXiv:2202.12853 全文22页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 现有Leslie–Ericksen/Beris–Edwards active-nematic models有许多难测参数，且可能不适合油水界面上的microtubule bundles。能否直接由实验director、velocity和order fields发现闭合、稀疏、可解释的PDE relations及系数？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: topological defects使director n不能全局连续，因此使用Q_ij=S n_i n_j及density/order proxy φ。SPIDER先用symmetry、tensor rank和derivative order生成候选terms，再以weak integral form降低实验微分噪声。
发现的是给定observables和library下的effective continuum relations；遗漏变量可能被吸收到系数或低阶terms中。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 对每种目标tensor/scalar relation，随机选择space-time integration domains，以smooth test functions把derivatives转移出noisy fields，构造feature matrix。iterative sparse regression沿residual–complexity Pareto curve删除terms。
候选模型用独立domains和symmetry tests验证，并从weak coefficients恢复strong form。原始荧光MT images、PIV velocity、Q/φ fields及confidence weights共同限定可靠区域。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figures 2–3展示SPIDER feature construction与稀疏selection。Figure 4比较identified strong-form terms的spatial fields：incompressibility近似成立，orientation transport与active/viscous/friction stresses在可靠区域相互平衡。
发现的结构类似经典active nematics，但该实验中elastic terms未被选中；动力学主要由active stress与friction/viscous response控制。Figure 5量化不同relations residual并显示defects附近误差更大。
‘elasticity不起作用’限定于此dataset、分辨率、library与operating regime；未选择不等于微观elasticity严格为零。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: velocity/director reconstruction和mask会系统影响terms；weak form减少noise却牺牲local resolution。候选库、maximum derivative/nonlinearity order和sparsity threshold构成强inductive bias。
只有一个主要experimental platform/regime，缺少外部预测experiment和perturbation validation。识别relations可能因feature collinearity不唯一，作者用多个domains和residual hierarchy缓解但未完全消除。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定field extraction、confidence masks、library table、weak-domain sizes/test functions、normalization、deletion path和model-selection elbow；应保留raw-to-field provenance。Evidence status: full-text verified theory/experiment study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–3 Figure 1与observables；pp.3–6 Figures 2–3看SPIDER；pp.6–9 Figures 4–5看发现方程；pp.10–16读methods；pp.17–22为supplementary推导。
